S50U26.five_day_thesis: Over five sessions the anchor fell 13.0 points from 1082.4 on 09-11 to 1069.4 while 1,763 puts were added and 502 calls removed, lifting P/C OI from 2.27 to 2.42. The decisive change is the ATM dealer-gamma sign flip: net GEX across the strikes nearest spot went from +11,354 on 09-11 to -1,427 today, and total chain GEX collapsed 81% from +11,138 to +2,120. The put build concentrated at 1070 (+547), 1040 (+414), 1030 (+347) and 1010 (+327), converting the shelf price used to sit on into a short-gamma pocket. The gamma flip migrated up from 1090 to 1100 over the same window, so the 30.6 points between spot and 1100 now amplify rather than dampen. ATM IV expanded 0.90 points from 12.21% to 13.11% across the slide - the structure is loosening into expiry, not compressing.

S50Z26.five_day_thesis: History for this series starts 2026-09-16, so this is a 3-session read rather than a 5-session one. Across those sessions call OI grew +287 to 2,933 and put OI +392 to 2,985, with the build concentrated at the 1100 call (+100) and the 1000 and 960 puts (+105 and +75), while every strike in the 1030-1080 near-money band added under 70 contracts. Net GEX round-tripped +190 on 09-16 to -96 on 09-17 and back to +189 today, which is noise at this OI rather than a regime change. ATM IV traced 12.95% to 13.70% to 12.63%, finishing at the 3-session low as the anchor recovered to 1070.7. With 102 days left and no strike above 532 OI, this is the Protection zone in its accumulation phase - the burden map is still being drawn.
